gpa.stat: average (no cohort year labeled on page)

salary_median_usd.stat: average salary, Fall and Spring Class of 2022 and Spring Class of 2023, at 6 months after graduation; school publishes no median

employment_rate_pct.stat: placement at 6 months after graduation, Fall and Spring Class of 2022 and Spring Class of 2023

notes: Haslam publishes no full-time MBA class profile page: no class size, GMAT/GRE, work experience, women or international percentages, or acceptance rate on any official page reached. Tuition: school publishes only 16-month PROGRAM totals combining tuition and fees, not annual tuition: program page shows Estimated Program Cost in-state 39125 and out-of-state 69968 (https://haslam.utk.edu/full-time-mba/); official 2026-2027 expense sheet (https://apply.haslam.utk.edu/www/documents/26-27%20Expenses/FTMBA%20Start-Up%20Expenses%202026-2027.pdf) shows program totals in-state 38982 and out-of-state 69825 with fees itemized, so no annual tuition-only figure exists. Salary figure is an average, not a median, and covers 2022 and 2023 classes; an older undated career brochure (2021 data) showed median base 97500 and 88 percent employed within 90 days but was not used because it is stale and unlabeled by class year.
